features.feature_value: Strongly favors letting both sides’ comments through regardless of political orientation; argues neither side should restrict others and frames bias as bad.
features.evidence_span: Any sort of political social media platform should let all comments through, no matter the side.
features.rationale: The participant explicitly states they allow both sides and oppose side-based restriction.

features.feature_value: Allows political voicing as long as there are no calls for violence.
features.evidence_span: As long as there wasn't any calls for violence, I didn't have a problem with either side voicing their opinion.
features.rationale: They define a specific content boundary (no calls for violence) as the main criterion.

features.feature_value: Keeps nonviolent discourse but removes content that wishes death on public figures.
features.evidence_span: I drew the line at wishing for deaths of public figures.
features.rationale: They describe a concrete “line” tied to harm/wishing death.

features.feature_value: Removes posts primarily when they contain vulgar/disgusting language; claims focus on being unbiased.
features.evidence_span: Some post had vulgar and disgusting language.So those were the ones I tended to remove.
features.rationale: They directly link vulgar/disgusting language to removal decisions.

features.feature_value: Judges based on how aggressive the author sounds and whether they are making a point.
features.evidence_span: I considered how aggressive the author sounded and if they were making any kind of point.
features.rationale: Their stated criteria emphasize perceived author aggression and argumentative intent.

features.feature_value: Wants to err on the side of not censoring posts.
features.evidence_span: I wanted to err on the side of not censoring posts
features.rationale: They state a general conservative-with-censorship principle.

features.feature_value: Opposes censorship/moderation; sees caustic/inflammatory expression as emotional release/catharsis and stress reduction.
features.evidence_span: I don't believe in censorship or moderating the responses.
features.rationale: They articulate a rationale for why they resist moderation decisions.

features.feature_value: Provides no meaningful reflection beyond a generic assertion that both views are wrong.
features.rationale: The reflection does not describe decision factors, suggesting limited engagement/detail.
